title: Film engine and first looks
intro: A film in Fonder is a set of colour moves baked into one lookup table, run through the same render graph as the viewfinder and the export.

title: Halation, starburst and grain
intro: The effects that make a frame read as film.

title: Fitting the camera simulations
intro: Four films were fitted to real camera renders instead of being authored by eye.

title: Recipes
intro: Recipes sit on top of films: dynamic range, tone, colour, white balance, grain and the rest.

title: Cine video
intro: The video mode: the recipe baked into every frame, built and measured here. It ships in a release after 1.0 — the first version of the app is Still and Roll.

title: Film Roll
intro: A third camera mode: load a film, shoot the roll without seeing it, then develop.
